resources.string: PREVIEW ONLY • NO FILES MOVED. Select one Downloads file to inspect a bounded sample offline. File changes remain disabled by safety gates.
Engineering build · Classification suggestions and preserved history

Inventory reads filenames, types, sizes and dates from Downloads. Preview type reads a bounded content sample from one selected regular file. Recovery may read and hash journaled files locally within strict limits. All processing stays offline. No folders are scanned recursively and no files are moved, copied, renamed or deleted.

This build’s read-only inventory requires Android 11 or newer. On Android 8–10, the dashboard is available but Downloads access is not supported. No legacy storage permission is requested.
